scope: Public same-contest implementations plus all 14 previously mirrored format/research repositories; current remote branch heads and selected source content. General framework links from the historical index are not cloned.
limits: Search indexes are not exhaustive; private, hidden, deleted, and unpushed branches are outside scope.
Partial clones retain complete commit topology; nonselected historical blobs and binary datasets may be absent.
General third-party submodules are listed in additional-tree-scope.json but not recursively cloned.
Interface declarations prove source relevance only, not algorithm legality, quality, or timing.
